summary: AMTD IDEA Group filed a Form 6-K (press release) announcing two acquisitions: (1) the completed acquisition of Dao by Dorsett Hornsey Hotel for ~US$30 million (all cash, no external financing), and (2) a definitive agreement to acquire historic Hornsey Town Hall for US$33 million. The hotel will be renamed AMTD Dao by Dorsett Hornsey. The Town Hall acquisition is subject to customary conditions, with expected closing in the near future. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for closing of Town Hall transaction; no risk-arb angle as hotel deal is already closed.
